name: WittyDVD
summary: DVD images with their real menus, chapters, angles and subtitles.
needs: FFmpeg, which comes with the server
updates: All of the engine: the disc's structure, menus, buttons and commands, where its video lies, and subtitles; and a DVD's page: its sections in every app, why a title is the film, and the names given to its titles and chapters, kept in its own database.
stays: The session code that turns steps into streams stays with the server, as does refusing encrypted discs and checking what the engine says, on purpose. Which title is a disc's film, and an administrator's choice of another, are kept with the server's copy of the disc.

logTopics: nav|Navigation|Every step the DVD navigator takes: program chains, cells and commands
menus|Menus and buttons|Each menu read from the disc, and each button pressed
